 Fox Corporation Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.
   

  

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 Fox Corporation Fox Corporation is home to industry\\-leading brands including FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations, and Tubi Media Group. We combine innovative technology, deep data insights, and world\\-class content to shape the future of digital entertainment. Our DTC platforms are built to deliver highly personalized, scalable user experiences to millions of global users.
   

  

**About The Role**
 FOX Corporation is looking for a SDET(L2\\) for its Digital Product Engineering Web team.
   

  

 Fox’s SDET is in charge of ensuring the highest quality release of our products. You will mainly be focused on building an automation framework for the project at hand and deciding the best end\\-to\\-end testing strategies for the product. The goal for this role is to increase automation test coverage so we can perform quick regression testing prior to each release. You will be working in an agile scrum team, responsible for performing various Quality Engineering functions, including designing test plans, bug reporting, and tools development.
   

  

 The candidate will design, develop, and maintain automated testing frameworks and tools to ensure the highest quality of our web applications across different browsers. You’ll collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and release engineers to deliver scalable, stable, and high\\-performing web products.
   

  

**A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**
* Create, maintain, and execute test plans and test cases against our software platforms and applications
* Analyze and communicate test results and defect tracking
* Execute white box, black box, and manual testing
* Participate in day\\-to\\-day team activities as part of an Agile team
* Engage in cross\\-functional integration testing within technology teams and with third parties
* Engage in requirements elaboration and clarification with the product owner
* Enhance and extend the automation library
* Contribute to performance and scalability testing efforts
* Provide the testing estimates to the team
* Mentor and share the testing practices with the scrum team
* Technical ownership of software testing infrastructure and improving product quality
* Take responsibility for monitoring product development and usage at all levels with an eye toward improving product quality
* Work on automation testing for all existing systems
* Support all production releases per sprint
* Research, develop and/or recommend tools to assist the team
* Work with TestRail/zephyr or any test management tools along with Jira


**WHAT YOU WILL NEED**
* An industry experience of 5 yrs\\+ in testing and automation
* Experience working with Appium
* Experience with Agile methodologies
* Experience with Git and CI tools
* Expertise with hands\\-on scripting/coding experience in any automation testing tools (Selenium/Appium), Cucumber Framework, or CodeceptJS
* Excellent communication, both verbal and written
* Experience with cloud\\-based device farms (BrowserStack/Sauce Labs/Headspin).

**About The Company**
 Dotcom Growth is a leading full\\-service digital marketing agency dedicated to driving growth for enterprise IT services clients, SaaS products, and digital marketing brands. Our team specializes in creating innovative strategies, comprehensive online campaigns, and technical solutions that help our clients achieve their business objectives. We pride ourselves on delivering measurable results through tailored marketing approaches, cutting\\-edge technology, and a collaborative work environment. At Dotcom Growth, we foster a culture of continuous learning and innovation, empowering our employees to develop their skills and grow professionally within a dynamic industry landscape.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a motivated and detail\\-oriented Website Development Intern to join our in\\-house development team. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands\\-on experience working on live website projects, including builds, revamps, and SEO implementations. The ideal candidate will have a foundational understanding of WordPress, HTML, CSS, and PHP, and a keen interest in web development and digital marketing. This internship is designed to be highly practical, with each task directly contributing to real\\-world projects. You will work closely with senior developers and SEO specialists, gaining invaluable insights into website development, optimization, and maintenance. The position is ideal for individuals looking to enhance their technical skills, build a professional portfolio, and explore a career in web development within a fast\\-paced digital marketing environment.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate should be currently pursuing or recently have completed a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Web Development, or a related field. Demonstrable hands\\-on experience with WordPress, including theme and plugin management, is essential. Basic to intermediate proficiency in HTML and CSS, with the ability to write and modify code independently, is required. Familiarity with PHP for WordPress template customization and functions.php edits is also necessary. A good understanding of on\\-page SEO principles such as meta tags, heading structure, image optimization, and page speed is preferred. The candidate should be able to work efficiently on real projects with deadlines, producing clean, functional, and responsive websites. A willingness to learn, accept feedback, and continuously improve is highly valued.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build, customize, and maintain WordPress websites, including theme customization, plugin configuration, and page builder work using tools like Elementor, Divi, or similar.
* Write and edit HTML and CSS code for front\\-end adjustments, layout fixes, responsive design, and custom styling to ensure optimal user experience.
* Utilize PHP for basic WordPress template modifications, creating custom functions, and plugin\\-level customizations to enhance website functionality.
* Assist the SEO team with on\\-page SEO tasks such as meta tags, heading structures, schema markup, image optimization, and internal linking on live pages.
* Support website revamp projects by migrating content, updating designs, restructuring URLs, and implementing redirects to improve site architecture and performance.
* Conduct basic website audits to identify issues like broken links, slow page loading, mobile responsiveness problems, and Core Web Vitals errors, implementing fixes under supervision.
* Participate in routine website maintenance, updates, and bug fixes across various client and in\\-house projects to ensure consistent performance and security.
* Maintain detailed documentation of all work performed, including notes on changes made, to facilitate review and future enhancements by senior developers.


**Benefits**
 As a Website Development Intern at Dotcom Growth, you will gain practical experience working on live projects within a collaborative team environment. You will have the opportunity to learn from experienced developers and SEO specialists, enhancing your technical skills and industry knowledge. The internship offers a stipend of INR 15,000 per month, with a duration of 60 to 90 days, and the possibility of full\\-time conversion based on performance. Immediate joiners are preferred. You will work on diverse projects that will strengthen your portfolio and prepare you for a professional career in web development. Additionally, you will develop valuable skills in WordPress, HTML, CSS, PHP, and SEO, which are highly sought after in the digital marketing industry.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe diversity fosters innovation and creativity, and we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. All employment decisions are made based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We encourage candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and join our team in contributing to our mission of driving digital growth and success.

**About The Company**
 Persistent Systems is a leading global technology company specializing in software product development and technology services. With a rich history of innovation and excellence, Persistent is committed to delivering transformative solutions that empower businesses across various industries. Our culture fosters creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning, enabling our employees to thrive in a dynamic and challenging environment. We prioritize diversity, inclusion, and sustainability, ensuring that our workplace is welcoming and supportive for all team members. As a trusted partner to many Fortune 500 companies, Persistent Systems stands at the forefront of technological advancements, helping clients achieve their strategic goals through innovative digital solutions.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Salesforce DevOps Engineer to join our team in Pune. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing CI/CD pipelines tailored for Salesforce platforms. Your expertise will help standardize development workflows, streamline release processes, and minimize deployment risks. You will own the end\\-to\\-end release management lifecycle, collaborating closely with development, QA, architecture, and operations teams to ensure seamless delivery of high\\-quality solutions. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work with cutting\\-edge technologies and contribute to the digital transformation initiatives of our clients. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in DevOps practices, Salesforce deployment automation, and release management, with a passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in Salesforce platform management, DevOps methodologies, and automation tools. A bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is required. Proven experience in creating and managing CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and environment governance is essential. Candidates should have a comprehensive understanding of branching strategies, packaging models, and quality gates to ensure robust deployment processes. Excellent collaboration skills are necessary to work effectively with cross\\-functional teams. Additionally, familiarity with DevSecOps practices, monitoring tools, and version control systems will be highly advantageous. A proactive mindset and a continuous learning attitude are critical for success in this role.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Salesforce DevOps Engineer will be responsible for the following key duties:
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce applications to facilitate validation, testing, deployment, and monitoring of releases.
* Standardize branching, packaging, and environment management processes across multiple teams to ensure consistency and efficiency.
* Implement automation solutions to reduce manual intervention, improve deployment speed, and enhance release quality.
* Establish and enforce quality gates, security controls, and DevSecOps practices to mitigate release risks and ensure compliance.
* Own the entire release lifecycle, from planning to execution, continuously identifying areas for process improvement.
* Collaborate with development, QA, architecture, and operations teams to align deployment strategies and resolve deployment issues.
* Monitor system performance and deployment metrics, providing insights to optimize the release process further.
* Maintain documentation of deployment procedures, configurations, and best practices for knowledge sharing and compliance purposes.


**Benefits**
 Persistent Systems offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees' well\\-being and professional growth. This includes a competitive salary structure complemented by various perks and incentives. We foster a culture focused on talent development, providing quarterly growth opportunities, and sponsoring higher education and certification programs to enhance your skills. Employees have the chance to work with the latest technologies and participate in innovative projects that make a real impact. Our engagement initiatives include project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards to recognize dedication. Additionally, we provide annual health check\\-ups and extensive insurance coverage, including group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization plans for employees and their families, ensuring peace of mind and health security.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 Persistent Systems is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering diversity and inclusion within our workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, regardless of gender, gender identity, or background. We support hybrid work arrangements and flexible hours to accommodate diverse lifestyles and needs. Our office facilities are accessibility\\-friendly, equipped with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities. If you have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any point during your employment. We believe that a diverse workforce drives innovation and success, and we are dedicated to providing an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.
   

  

 Let’s unleash your full potential at Persistent \\- persistent.com/careers
   

  

*“Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.”*
